title: Perfect parking · Level 1: The bay at 54 cm
brief: Park in the bay: stop with the robot's front bumper between the bay's lines (50 and 58 cm on the ruler; its middle line at 54 cm). 30 s. 50 for parked, up to 40 for closeness to the middle line (all 40 within 1 cm, 10 at a bay line), 10 for touching no cone. No par: parking is about where, not how fast.

score.run: round(if(stopped & (endX + front * cosd(endHeading) - s0) >= lo & (endX + front * cosd(endHeading) - s0) <= hi, 50 + min(40, 50 - abs((endX + front * cosd(endHeading) - s0) - mid) / 10 * 10), 0) + if(touchesOf_coneL + touchesOf_coneR == 0, 10, 0), 1)

finished.value: count(r in runs: r.stopped & (r.endX + front * cosd(r.endHeading) - s0) >= lo & (r.endX + front * cosd(r.endHeading) - s0) <= hi)

sources.where: G2.1 Measure the world, Challenge — Perfect parking: the lane, the ruler from the start line (here x 200), the front bumper (the Junior robot's front 90 mm), the bay, the level table (level 1), the scoring paragraph; "How a run is measured". The cones read as 150 mm high, 80 mm across, 200 mm either side of the lane's middle; the bay's lines 10 mm wide, centred on their marks
